learning.learning_goal: Connect one, two, and three spoken names and numerals to groups of objects.
learning.big_idea: Count each object once. The last number names the whole group.
novice_success_criteria: hear and identify one, two, and three
count each object once in unfamiliar arrangements
make a requested group of two or three
match quantities to numerals without an answer in the picture

screens.label: Start here
screens.title: Meet 1, 2, and 3.
screens.body: Listen. Tap the dots. Try making some dots.
screens.audio: Let's meet one, two, and three. Tap Listen whenever you want to hear me again.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Look at the dot. How many? Tap the number.

choices.feedback: Touch the dot. There is one.

hints: Touch the dot in the box.
One dot matches 1.

screens.title: 2 — two
screens.audio: One, two. Two dots. Tap each dot.

visual.ariaLabel: Two dots to tap from left to right.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Touch each dot as you count. How many?

choices.feedback: There is another dot. Count both.
Touch each dot once. Count again.

hints: Touch the left dot. Then the right dot.
One, two. There are two.

screens.title: 3 — three
screens.audio: One, two, three. Three dots. Tap each dot.

visual.ariaLabel: Three dots to tap from left to right.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Touch each dot as you count. How many?

choices.feedback: Count every dot, not only the first.

hints: Touch each dot, from left to right.
One, two, three. There are three.

screens.title: Make 2 dots.
screens.audio: Tap Add a dot two times. Stop at two. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Touch and count your dots. Add or remove one, then check again.
hints: Tap Add a dot. Count aloud as each dot appears.
One, two. Stop when there are two dots.

screens.title: Make 3 dots.
screens.audio: Now make three dots. Add dots until you have three. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Touch and count your dots. Add or remove one, then check again.
hints: Add a dot and count it. Keep going.
One, two, three. Stop at three dots.

screens.title: The dots moved.
screens.audio: The dots moved. Count them again. How many?

choices.feedback: Touch each dot once. There are two.
Still two. Moving them did not add a dot.

hints: Start at either dot. Count both.
One, two. The total is still two.

screens.title: Find one dot.
screens.audio: Here is a different dot. How many dots?
hints: Touch the dot you see.
One dot matches 1.

screens.title: How many in the whole group?
screens.audio: One, two, three. Three dots in all.
screens.hook: One, two, three. Three dots in all.
screens.body: The last number you count names how many dots are in the whole group.

screens.title: Count these dots.
screens.audio: The dots are in new places. Count each one. How many?

visual.ariaLabel: Three scattered dots with no number labels.

hints: Touch each dot once. Do not skip one.
Count: one, two, three.

screens.title: Which number means two?
screens.audio: One, two. Which number means two?

choices.feedback: Three would need one more dot.

hints: Point to each dot and count.
One, two. Tap 2.

screens.title: A new group.

visual.ariaLabel: One dot in a new place, without a number label.

hints: Touch the dot you see.
There is one dot.

screens.title: You met 1, 2, and 3.
screens.body: Come back and count new groups again.
screens.audio: You met one, two, and three. Come back and count again.
